statement: file_id=SRC-07;file_class=SOURCE;authority_level=2;governed_by=GOV-00;status=ACTIVE
violation: SRC-07 lacks the canonical FILE-META record or uses a non-ACTIVE status without higher-authority direction.
verification: Verify the first SRC-07 metadata record exactly matches the canonical metadata statement.

statement: SRC-07 owns Read Model derivation semantics, sync semantics, freshness semantics, rebuild semantics, projection semantics, and derived-view authority-boundary semantics.
violation: A generated source record routes SRC-07-owned Read Model derivation, sync, freshness, rebuild, projection, or derived-view authority-boundary semantics to a file other than SRC-07.
verification: Check Read Model records against SRC-INDEX responsibility routing.

statement: SRC-07 owns READ-* record ids.
violation: A generated source record defines READ-* semantics outside SRC-07.
verification: Validate READ-* record ownership against SRC-INDEX namespace routing.

statement: SRC-07 is a SOURCE class governed file.
violation: SRC-07 is generated with any class other than SOURCE.
verification: Validate the class field of every SRC-07 record equals SOURCE.

statement: SRC-07 has authority_level 2.
violation: SRC-07 is generated with any authority_level other than 2.
verification: Validate the authority_level field of every SRC-07 record equals 2.

statement: SRC-07 must not define source truth owned by SRC-00, SRC-01, SRC-02, SRC-03, SRC-04, SRC-05, SRC-06, or SRC-08 through SRC-10.
violation: A SRC-07 record defines source truth routed to another SRC file by SRC-INDEX.
verification: Compare each SRC-07 statement against SRC-INDEX responsibility and namespace maps.

statement: Read Model Canister provides query-optimized derived views.
violation: Read Model Canister is treated as unavailable for query-optimized derived views.
verification: Review Read Model role claims for query-optimized derived view service.

statement: Read Model is not authoritative.
violation: Read Model is treated as authoritative source truth for balance-affecting correctness.
verification: Review Read Model boundary claims for non-authoritative status.

statement: Read Model projections are derived state.
violation: Read Model projection state is treated as authoritative Ledger Core state.
verification: Review projection records for derived-state classification.

statement: Read Model correctness must depend on Ledger Core source data or Ledger Core journal records.
violation: Read Model correctness is derived from any source other than Ledger Core source data or Ledger Core journal records.
verification: Review Read Model derivation inputs for Ledger Core state or journal source data.

statement: Read Model must not be treated as Ledger Core truth.
violation: Read Model projection state is treated as Ledger Core truth.
verification: Review authority comparisons between Read Model state and Ledger Core/journal state.

statement: Read Model must not be part of the authoritative commit path.
violation: A Ledger Core authoritative commit requires Read Model participation.
verification: Review commit path for exclusion of Read Model from authoritative commit success.

statement: Read Model role claims must not be inferred from code, tests, README, UI, logs, or runtime behavior.
violation: A Read Model role claim is justified by code, tests, README, UI, logs, or runtime behavior instead of governed source authority.
verification: Review Read Model role claims for trace to governed source authority.

statement: Read Model corruption must not compromise Ledger Core correctness.
violation: Read Model corruption changes Ledger Core authoritative correctness.
verification: Inject or simulate Read Model corruption and verify Ledger Core state, journal, operations, and idempotency outcomes remain unchanged.

statement: Read Model must not mutate Ledger Core authoritative state.
violation: Read Model mutates Ledger Core authoritative state.
verification: Review mutation paths for absence of Read Model writes to Ledger Core state.

statement: Read Model must not authorize balance-affecting operations.
violation: Read Model authorizes a balance-affecting operation.
verification: Review authorization paths for exclusion of Read Model authority.

statement: Read Model must not reject balance-affecting operations.
violation: Read Model rejects a balance-affecting operation as authoritative business logic.
verification: Review rejection paths for exclusion of Read Model authority.

statement: Read Model must not approve balance-affecting operations.
violation: Read Model approves a balance-affecting operation as authoritative business logic.
verification: Review approval paths for exclusion of Read Model authority.

statement: Read Model must not execute balance-affecting operations.
violation: Read Model executes a balance-affecting operation.
verification: Review execution paths for absence of Read Model operation execution.

statement: Read Model must not affect balance-affecting correctness.
violation: Read Model state, sync, rebuild, lag, or failure changes balance-affecting correctness.
verification: Review balance-affecting correctness claims for exclusion of Read Model dependence.

statement: Read Model must not affect Ledger Core commit success.
violation: Ledger Core commit success depends on Read Model state, sync, rebuild, or freshness.
verification: Review commit success conditions for exclusion of Read Model state.

statement: Read Model state must not be used as proof that a Ledger Core commit occurred.
violation: Read Model state is used as authoritative proof that a Ledger Core commit occurred.
verification: Review commit proof logic for reliance on Operation and LedgerEntry authority instead of projection state.

statement: Read Model state must not be used as proof that a Ledger Core commit did not occur.
violation: Read Model absence or lag is used as authoritative proof that a Ledger Core commit did not occur.
verification: Review absence-proof logic for reliance on Ledger Core/journal source data instead of projection state.

statement: Read Model must not override authoritative Ledger Core or journal state.
violation: Read Model projection overrides Ledger Core state or journal history.
verification: Review conflict resolution rules for Ledger Core and journal priority over projection state.

statement: Read Model must be rebuildable from Ledger Core state.
violation: Read Model cannot be rebuilt from Ledger Core source state when that state is valid and available.
verification: Run rebuild review comparing projection state to Ledger Core source-derived expected state.

statement: Read Model must be rebuildable from Ledger Core journal records.
violation: Read Model cannot be rebuilt from Ledger Core journal records when journal records are valid and available.
verification: Run rebuild review comparing projection state to journal-derived expected state.

statement: Read Model sync must use Ledger Core journal or checkpoint data as its source.
violation: Read Model sync uses any source other than Ledger Core journal or checkpoint data.
verification: Review sync inputs for Ledger Core journal/checkpoint source data only.

statement: Read Model must not infer missing authoritative events.
violation: Read Model infers an authoritative event absent from Ledger Core source data.
verification: Compare projection events against Ledger Core source data and reject inferred missing events.

statement: Read Model must not synthesize Ledger Core events that are absent from authoritative source data.
violation: Read Model synthesizes a Ledger Core event absent from authoritative source data.
verification: Compare projected events against authoritative Operation and LedgerEntry records.

statement: Read Model projection must not treat external user input as source truth.
violation: Read Model projection treats external user input as authoritative source truth.
verification: Review projection inputs for exclusion of external user input as source truth.

statement: Read Model projection must not treat Gateway request data as authoritative commit truth.
violation: Read Model projection treats Gateway request data as authoritative commit truth.
verification: Review projection inputs for exclusion of Gateway request data as commit proof.

statement: Read Model projection must not treat prior projection state as authoritative source truth.
violation: Read Model projection treats prior projection state as authoritative source truth.
verification: Review projection derivation for source truth from Ledger Core state, journal, or checkpoint data only.

statement: Journal history is more authoritative than Read Model projection, while journal authority remains owned by SRC-05.
violation: Read Model projection is treated as more authoritative than journal history or SRC-07 redefines journal authority.
verification: Review source-priority rules for journal history over projection state with journal semantics routed to SRC-05.

statement: Read Model sync may occur after Ledger Core commit.
violation: Read Model sync after Ledger Core commit is treated as forbidden without active source authority.
verification: Review sync scheduling for occurrence only after Ledger Core commit.

statement: Read Model sync must not be required for Ledger Core commit success.
violation: Ledger Core commit success requires Read Model sync completion.
verification: Review commit path for no dependency on Read Model sync completion.

statement: Read Model sync must use Ledger Core journal or checkpoint data.
violation: Read Model sync uses non-Ledger-Core journal or non-checkpoint data as authoritative source.
verification: Review sync source inputs for Ledger Core journal or checkpoint data.

statement: Read Model sync must track the last processed journal cursor.
violation: Read Model sync does not track the last processed journal cursor.
verification: Inspect projection freshness and sync state for last processed journal cursor tracking.

statement: Read Model sync must not skip committed LedgerEntry records.
violation: Read Model sync skips one or more committed LedgerEntry records.
verification: Compare sync cursor progression against committed LedgerEntry ordering.

statement: Read Model sync must not advance freshness beyond processed authoritative source data.
violation: Projection freshness advances beyond processed authoritative source data.
verification: Compare freshness boundary against processed Ledger Core journal or checkpoint data.

statement: Read Model sync must not mark unprocessed LedgerEntry records as processed.
violation: Read Model sync marks an unprocessed LedgerEntry as processed.
verification: Compare last processed LedgerEntry marker against actual processed journal entries.

statement: Read Model sync must not mutate Ledger Core authoritative state.
violation: Read Model sync mutates Ledger Core authoritative state.
verification: Review sync write paths for absence of Ledger Core authoritative state mutation.

statement: Read Model sync failure must not roll back Ledger Core commit, while failure classification remains owned by SRC-06 and atomicity remains owned by SRC-05.
violation: Read Model sync failure rolls back Ledger Core commit or SRC-07 redefines failure or atomicity semantics.
verification: Inject sync failure after commit and verify Ledger Core committed state remains unchanged.

statement: Read Model sync must be observable through projection freshness.
violation: Read Model sync state cannot be inspected through projection freshness.
verification: Inspect projection freshness before and after sync to verify visible cursor or freshness movement.

statement: Read Model rebuild must be deterministic from Ledger Core journal state.
violation: Read Model rebuild from the same Ledger Core journal state produces different projection states.
verification: Rebuild projection twice from the same journal state and compare projection outputs.

statement: Read Model projections may be deleted and rebuilt without changing Ledger Core truth.
violation: Deleting or rebuilding Read Model projections changes Ledger Core truth.
verification: Delete and rebuild projection state and verify Ledger Core state and journal are unchanged.

statement: Read Model rebuild must not mutate Ledger Core authoritative state.
violation: Read Model rebuild mutates Ledger Core authoritative state.
verification: Review rebuild paths for absence of Ledger Core authoritative writes.

statement: Read Model rebuild must not create Ledger Core journal records.
violation: Read Model rebuild creates Ledger Core journal records.
verification: Compare journal record count before and after rebuild.

statement: Read Model rebuild must not rewrite Ledger Core journal records.
violation: Read Model rebuild rewrites Ledger Core journal records.
verification: Compare journal records before and after rebuild for no rewrite.

statement: Read Model rebuild must not infer missing authoritative events.
violation: Read Model rebuild infers authoritative events absent from Ledger Core source data.
verification: Compare rebuild output against Operation and LedgerEntry source data only.

statement: Read Model rebuild must produce projection state explainable from Ledger Core source data.
violation: Read Model rebuild produces projection state not explainable from Ledger Core source data.
verification: Trace every rebuilt projection element to Ledger Core state, journal, or checkpoint data.

statement: Read Model rebuild may be used after projection corruption.
violation: Projection corruption is treated as unrecoverable despite valid Ledger Core source data.
verification: Corrupt projection state and verify deterministic rebuild repairs the projection from source data.

statement: Read Model rebuild may be used after upgrade when projections are treated as rebuildable derived state.
violation: Read Model rebuild after upgrade is rejected even though projections are treated as rebuildable derived state.
verification: Review upgrade recovery path for optional projection rebuild after upgrade.

statement: Rebuild determinism must be observable by comparing rebuilt projection to authoritative source-derived expected state.
violation: Rebuild determinism cannot be observed by comparison to source-derived expected state.
verification: Run projection comparison between rebuilt output and source-derived expected state.

statement: Read Model must expose projection freshness.
violation: Read Model projection freshness is unavailable or uninspectable.
verification: Inspect Read Model projection freshness fields or query response metadata.

statement: ProjectionFreshness has lastProcessedLedgerEntryId.
violation: ProjectionFreshness lacks lastProcessedLedgerEntryId.
verification: Review ProjectionFreshness field registry for lastProcessedLedgerEntryId.

statement: ProjectionFreshness has lastProcessedOperationId.
violation: ProjectionFreshness lacks lastProcessedOperationId.
verification: Review ProjectionFreshness field registry for lastProcessedOperationId.

statement: ProjectionFreshness has lastSyncAt.
violation: ProjectionFreshness lacks lastSyncAt.
verification: Review ProjectionFreshness field registry for lastSyncAt.

statement: ProjectionFreshness has sourceCanisterId.
violation: ProjectionFreshness lacks sourceCanisterId.
verification: Review ProjectionFreshness field registry for sourceCanisterId.

statement: lastProcessedLedgerEntryId identifies the latest authoritative LedgerEntry processed by the projection.
violation: lastProcessedLedgerEntryId identifies anything other than the latest authoritative LedgerEntry processed by the projection.
verification: Compare lastProcessedLedgerEntryId against processed LedgerEntry sequence.

statement: lastProcessedOperationId identifies the latest authoritative Operation processed by the projection.
violation: lastProcessedOperationId identifies anything other than the latest authoritative Operation processed by the projection.
verification: Compare lastProcessedOperationId against processed Operation sequence.

statement: lastSyncAt identifies when projection sync last completed or advanced.
violation: lastSyncAt is used for any semantic other than identifying when projection sync last completed or advanced.
verification: Review lastSyncAt updates against sync completion or advancement events.

statement: sourceCanisterId identifies the Ledger Core source canister used for projection data.
violation: sourceCanisterId identifies a source other than the Ledger Core source canister used for projection data.
verification: Review sourceCanisterId against the Ledger Core canister source used by projection sync.

statement: Read Model query responses should expose freshness metadata when relevant.
violation: A relevant Read Model query response omits freshness metadata without explicit justification.
verification: Review derived query responses for freshness metadata where stale projection risk matters.

statement: Projection freshness must not claim processing beyond authoritative journal or checkpoint data.
violation: Projection freshness claims processing beyond authoritative journal or checkpoint data.
verification: Compare freshness markers against authoritative journal or checkpoint boundaries.

statement: Projection freshness must be inspectable for lag diagnosis.
violation: Projection freshness cannot be inspected for lag diagnosis.
verification: Inspect freshness metadata and compare it against Ledger Core journal boundary.

statement: Projection freshness must not replace authoritative commit timestamp semantics owned by SRC-05.
violation: Projection freshness is treated as authoritative commit timestamp semantics or SRC-07 redefines timestamp ownership.
verification: Review timestamp semantics for projection freshness as diagnostic metadata only.

statement: Read Model may lag behind Ledger Core.
violation: Read Model lag is treated as forbidden without active source authority.
verification: Review derived read semantics for allowed projection lag.

statement: Read Model lag must not block Transfer commit.
violation: Transfer commit is blocked by Read Model lag.
verification: Inject Read Model lag and verify Ledger Core Transfer commit path remains independent.

statement: Read Model lag must not invalidate Ledger Core commit.
violation: Ledger Core commit is invalidated because Read Model projection lags.
verification: Inject Read Model lag and verify committed Operation and LedgerEntry truth remain valid.

statement: Read Model lag must not be interpreted as absence of authoritative Ledger Core state.
violation: Read Model lag or absence is treated as proof that authoritative Ledger Core state does not exist.
verification: Compare projection freshness against Ledger Core source data before claiming absence.

statement: Read Model lag must be observable through projection freshness.
violation: Read Model lag is not observable through projection freshness.
verification: Compare projection freshness markers against Ledger Core journal boundary.

statement: Read Model lag must not cause duplicate balance effects.
violation: Read Model lag causes duplicate balance effects.
verification: Inject lag and duplicate request sequence and verify no additional balance effects occur.

statement: Read Model lag must not cause idempotency replay divergence.
violation: Read Model lag causes idempotency replay to diverge from stored deterministic outcome.
verification: Replay duplicate requests under lag and compare deterministic stored outcomes.

statement: Read Model lag must not authorize or reject a balance-affecting operation.
violation: Read Model lag authorizes or rejects a balance-affecting operation.
verification: Review balance-affecting decision paths for no dependence on projection lag.

statement: Stale projection reads must remain distinguishable from authoritative Ledger Core reads where freshness metadata is exposed.
violation: A stale projection read is indistinguishable from an authoritative Ledger Core read where freshness metadata is exposed.
verification: Inspect query responses for freshness metadata distinguishing derived projection reads from authoritative source reads.

statement: Read Model may serve account balance views as derived reads.
violation: Read Model account balance derived views are treated as forbidden without active source authority.
verification: Review Read Model query registry for account balance derived reads only.

statement: Read Model may serve account summaries as derived reads.
violation: Read Model account summary derived views are treated as forbidden without active source authority.
verification: Review Read Model query registry for account summary derived reads only.

statement: Read Model may serve operation summaries as derived reads.
violation: Read Model operation summary derived views are treated as forbidden without active source authority.
verification: Review Read Model query registry for operation summary derived reads only.

statement: Read Model may serve projection freshness as a derived read.
violation: Read Model projection freshness derived read is treated as forbidden without active source authority.
verification: Review Read Model query registry for projection freshness derived reads.

statement: Derived reads must not mutate Ledger Core authoritative state.
violation: A derived read mutates Ledger Core authoritative state.
verification: Review derived read paths for absence of Ledger Core authoritative writes.

statement: Derived reads must not create Operation records.
violation: A derived read creates an Operation record.
verification: Review derived read paths for absence of Operation creation.

statement: Derived reads must not create LedgerEntry records.
violation: A derived read creates a LedgerEntry record.
verification: Review derived read paths for absence of LedgerEntry creation.

statement: Derived reads must not modify Balance records.
violation: A derived read modifies a Balance record.
verification: Review derived read paths for absence of Balance mutation.

statement: Derived reads must not patch Operation lifecycle state.
violation: A derived read patches Operation lifecycle state.
verification: Review derived read paths for absence of lifecycle patching.

statement: Derived reads must not create idempotency outcomes.
violation: A derived read creates an idempotency outcome.
verification: Review derived read paths for absence of idempotency outcome creation.

statement: Derived reads must disclose freshness when required by READ-* freshness rules.
violation: A derived read omits required freshness disclosure.
verification: Inspect derived read responses for required freshness metadata.

statement: Read Model corruption must not alter authoritative balances.
violation: Read Model corruption alters authoritative balances.
verification: Corrupt projection state and verify authoritative Balance records are unchanged.

statement: Read Model corruption must not alter authoritative LedgerEntry records.
violation: Read Model corruption alters authoritative LedgerEntry records.
verification: Corrupt projection state and verify LedgerEntry records are unchanged.

statement: Read Model corruption must not alter authoritative Operation records.
violation: Read Model corruption alters authoritative Operation records.
verification: Corrupt projection state and verify Operation records are unchanged.

statement: Read Model corruption must not alter idempotency outcomes.
violation: Read Model corruption alters idempotency outcomes.
verification: Corrupt projection state and verify idempotency outcome records are unchanged.

statement: Read Model corruption must be repairable by deterministic rebuild when authoritative source data remains valid.
violation: Read Model corruption cannot be repaired by deterministic rebuild despite valid authoritative source data.
verification: Corrupt projection state, rebuild from source data, and compare rebuilt projection to expected state.

statement: Projection corruption must not be hidden as authoritative Ledger Core truth.
violation: Projection corruption is presented as authoritative Ledger Core truth.
verification: Review diagnostic and query behavior for separation of projection corruption from authoritative source truth.

statement: Projection corruption must not force Ledger Core rollback.
violation: Projection corruption forces Ledger Core rollback.
verification: Inject projection corruption and verify Ledger Core committed state is not rolled back.

statement: Projection corruption must not weaken journal append-only requirements.
violation: Projection corruption weakens journal append-only requirements.
verification: Verify journal append-only rules remain enforced during projection corruption.

statement: Projection corruption must not weaken idempotency replay requirements.
violation: Projection corruption weakens idempotency replay requirements.
verification: Replay duplicate requests after projection corruption and verify deterministic idempotency behavior remains intact.

statement: Read Model projections may be deleted and rebuilt after upgrade without changing Ledger Core truth.
violation: Deleting or rebuilding Read Model projections after upgrade changes Ledger Core truth.
verification: Delete and rebuild projections after upgrade and verify Ledger Core truth remains unchanged.

statement: Read Model rebuild after upgrade must source from Ledger Core state or journal records.
violation: Read Model rebuild after upgrade sources from non-Ledger-Core or non-journal authoritative data.
verification: Review post-upgrade rebuild inputs for Ledger Core state or journal records.

statement: Read Model rebuild after upgrade must not rewrite journal history.
violation: Read Model rebuild after upgrade rewrites journal history.
verification: Compare journal history before and after post-upgrade projection rebuild.

statement: Read Model rebuild after upgrade must not fabricate missing LedgerEntry records.
violation: Read Model rebuild after upgrade fabricates LedgerEntry records absent from authoritative source data.

statement: Upgrade success must not depend on derived projection correctness unless active SRC-08 authority explicitly requires a projection check.
violation: Upgrade success depends on derived projection correctness without active SRC-08 authority.
verification: Review upgrade acceptance criteria for no projection correctness dependency unless routed to SRC-08.

statement: Projection freshness after upgrade must identify the processed source data boundary.
violation: Projection freshness after upgrade lacks a processed source data boundary.

statement: Read Model update failure must not corrupt Ledger Core.
violation: Read Model update failure corrupts Ledger Core state.

statement: Read Model update failure must not roll back Ledger Core.
violation: Read Model update failure rolls back Ledger Core committed state.

statement: Read Model update failure must be classified through SRC-06 failure authority.

statement: Read Model sync failure must not become authoritative business rejection.

statement: Read Model rebuild failure must not mutate Ledger Core authoritative state.
violation: Read Model rebuild failure mutates Ledger Core authoritative state.

statement: Read Model failure handling must preserve Ledger Core source truth.

statement: SRC-07 must not define canister authority or caller identity semantics.

statement: SRC-07 must not define ledger-entry, journal, invariant, timestamp, commit, or atomicity semantics.

statement: SRC-07 must not define failure-class semantics.

statement: SRC-07 must not define upgrade or stable-state mechanics.
